newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean shipbuilding shares up on rising orders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean shipbuilding shares up on rising orders.

text.p: Shares of Daewoo Heavy Industries Co Ltd and other South Korean shipbuildiers rose early on Friday on news the nation's shipbuilding orders rose 166.7 percent in the first quarter of this year from a year-ago period.
Daewoo Heavy rose 170 won to 4,620, Hanjin Heavy Industries Co Ltd 180 won to 7,150 and Samsung Heavy Industries Co Ltd 150 won to 7,550.
On Thursday, the Korea Shipbuilders' Association said shipbuilding orders in the three-month period rose to 1.67 million gross tonnes from 627,600 gross tonnes the same period a year ago.
Brokers said the rise in shipbuilding shares helped boost overall sentiment on the Seoul bourse in early trading.
